# LTX-2.3 IC-Lora Outpaint Model

- [IC-Lora Outpaint Model Card](https://huggingface.co/oumoumad/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Outpaint)
- [Download Link](https://huggingface.co/oumoumad/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Outpaint/resolve/main/ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-outpaint.safetensors)



### Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   └── 📂 loras/
│   │      └── ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-outpaint.safetensors
```

***
## ComfyUI-LTXVideo
- [Repository](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo)
> - Search *LTXVideo* in ComfyUI Manager.
> - Provides the **🅛🅣🅧 Add Video IC-LoRA Guide** node required to use the outpainting lora.

## comfy-mtb
- [Repository](https://github.com/melMass/comfy_mtb)
> - Search *mtb* in ComfyUI Manager.
> - Provides the **Color Correct (mtb)** node. 
> - Only required if you need the gamma correction feature of this workflow.
> - Gamma correction can be used to temporarily brighten the input video to help the Lora correctly identify which areas to paint. [Note about this from the Lora developer](https://huggingface.co/oumoumad/LTX-2.3-22b-IC-LoRA-Outpaint#%E2%9A%A0%EF%B8%8F-dark-scenes-use-a-gamma-correction-trick).

## KJNodes
- [Repository](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
> - Search *kjnodes* in ComfyUI Manager.
> - Provides get/set nodes and **LTX2 Sampling Preview Override** for sampler previews.

## Wan VACE Prep
- [Repository](https://github.com/stuttlepress/ComfyUI-Wan-VACE-Prep)
> - v1.0.19 or higher required
> - Search *Wan VACE Prep* in ComfyUI Manager
> - Provides the **🪐 Video Outpaint** node.

# How to Use This Workflow

## 1. Install the requirements listed above.

## 2. Select models
* Point the brown Load nodes at the checkpoint and loras on your system. This workflow expects to run with full LTX-2.3 dev models and distilled lora.

## 3. Load your video
* 

## 4. Run *just the VACE Outpaint Prep node* to populate it with your video.  
Do one of the following:
   * Click the node, then click the blue **Run** button in the icon bar that appears above it (not the Run button at the top of the ComfyUI window).
   * If you have [rgthree](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) installed, right click the node and select *Queue Selected Output Nodes (rgthree)*.  

After your video has loaded, you can scrub through it with the **frame** slider. This has no effect on output.
## 5. Select output.  
   * Adjust the selection box to frame your desired output. Red areas will be generated by the VACE model. 
   * Confirm **output resolution** matches your target.
   * Confirm *LTX (Black)* is selected for **Pad Color**.
## 7. Prompt.
Enter a prompt describing the scene, especially what's in the outpainted area.
## 8. Run the workflow.
The outpainted video will be placed in your ComfyUI *output* directory, named something like `outpainted_0001.mp4`
